passages.provision_quote: The resolution is meant to secure the southern border by allowing local law enforcement officers to arrest those who cross the border illegally.
passages.note: Bill gives local police arrest power over illegal border crossing; this is an entry-enforcement dimension, not the deportation-scope of already-present undocumented immigrants the rungs order.
passages.actor_quote: Democratic Senator Brian Fernandez, who voted against it
passages.tally_quote: In a 16 to 13 vote, with one senator not voting

rows.reasoning: The only source is a No vote on HCR 2060, which the article describes as authorizing local law enforcement to arrest people who cross the border illegally. That operative content concerns entry/arrest enforcement at the border, not the ladder's question of how far to go deporting undocumented immigrants already in the country, so the passage is adjacent/off-axis and cannot establish a rung.

Fernandez's own statements, if any, specifically about deportation scope for long-settled undocumented immigrants

quotes.text: The measure will not make it safer, it will not save us money, it will costs us unnecessary and irreversible harm
